contract.native_control: Production launch binding, compiler client/host, SDK dispatch and original native conversation. No GUI authorization submitted.
contract.resource_limit_scope: Aggregate committed memory per Windows compiler job; not a physical RAM or OS CPU cap.

task_spec.prompt: Compile and test a C++17 program that writes exactly "23 units" to stdout. Correct a compiler error if necessary, then report the actual result.

copied_database_diagnosis.historical_limit: The reproduction explains a concrete failure mechanism; it does not recover the missing original before/after inventory.
copied_database_diagnosis.immutable_control: Immutable reads of both the complete copied bundle and proven-empty-WAL main-only copy changed no files. All four cases had identical SQL contents: six messages and one session.
copied_database_diagnosis.observed: After proving the saved WAL empty, the mode=ro native reader on a main-file-only copy created an empty WAL and 32768-byte SHM identical to the original audit-time sidecars; the main database remained unchanged.
copied_database_diagnosis.scope: Disposable copies only; no original database opened or SDK/compiler/model rerun.

environment.compiler: Clang 22.1.3 with pinned clang-cl and LLD; exact executable hashes are in the linked native-template record

full_harness_result.boundary: After the SDK worker joined and all semantic checks in closed_audit succeeded; its final whole-tree hash comparison failed.
full_harness_result.limitation: The harness did not retain its before/after maps, so we cannot assert that only SQLite sidecars changed during the original audit. The failed receipt remains unchanged.
full_harness_result.separate_review: The later 54-check review verifies the narrower core result using closed artifacts and immutable database copies. It does not convert attempt 04 into a full harness pass.
